final_message:
No — the frozen tools cannot rebuild this repository for a remote operating system.

I checked all four reachable handles (repo, tests, git, episodes) with this exact goal. The repo itself is clean/stable on branch master, but none of the environments expose a capability for cross-compiling/rebuilding against a remote target OS — each returned "requested capability is unavailable in the reachable world." There's no toolchain path in this frozen state that supports building for anything other than the current (local) environment, so a remote-OS rebuild is not achievable with the currently available frozen tools.
